::: {.callout-tip title="TL;DR" icon="false"}
**Diffusion models** learn to reverse a noise process — iteratively denoising a signal toward data.
Replacing the U-Net backbone with a **Transformer block (DiT)** unified the denoising architecture
with the LLM stack, enabling image, video, and audio generation at scale.
:::

**Depends on:** [The Transformer](02_transformer.qmd) · [Multimodal](11_multimodal.qmd)
